clue.text: Old Admiralty officer looks sound

indicators.note: sound here means 'is heard as', so the word for looks is said aloud

parts.note: to look quickly is to peep, so looks gives peeps

explanation.surface: An elderly naval official appears to be in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' seems to mean healthy, describing how the officer looks; it is the homophone signal. Samuel Pepys, the diarist, was a senior official of the Navy Board.
explanation.definitionFit: The diarist Samuel Pepys ran naval administration in the 17th century, so he is an old Admiralty official.

clue.text: Tool thus taken surprisingly for carrying on shoulders

parts.note: a pick is a digging tool
to be taken aback is to be surprised

explanation.surface: An implement, so unexpectedly picked up, is hoisted onto one's back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thus' is a link: 'taken aback' means surprised, so 'taken surprisingly' gives ABACK.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickaback is an older form of piggyback, a ride on someone's back and shoulders.

clue.text: Emotion at success of Cats?

definitions.meaning: a group of lions is collectively called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both self-satisfaction at achievement and the collective noun for lions.

clue.text: Sound judgment to lift fuel to 'Berlin, say

indicators.note: lift in a down clue raises the word for fuel, reading it upwards

parts.note: gas is a fuel
to as in 'ten to a box' means a, one
Berlin is an example of a city

explanation.surface: Wise judgment means raising fuel supplies for the German capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lift' reverses GAS to SAG in this down clue; 'to' stands for A, as in 'six to a pack'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagacity is wisdom and keen discernment.

clue.text: Former colony's support line protected by soldier and sailor

indicators.note: something protected by others is surrounded by them, so the support and line sit between soldier and sailor

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
TAR is a crossword sailor (Jack Tar)
a bra is a supporting garment

explanation.surface: A one-time colony's line of defence is guarded by the army and navy.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'Former colony' is a link meaning 'is'; 'protected by' means the support and line sit inside the soldier-and-sailor pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Gibraltar was ceded to Britain in 1713 and was long a Crown colony, now an overseas territory.

clue.text: Good old politician speaking without difficulty

parts.note: a Lib was a member of the old Liberal Party

explanation.surface: A fine veteran MP talks fluently.
explanation.walkthrough: The Liberal Party merged into the Liberal Democrats in 1988, so a Lib is an old politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A glib talker is smooth and fluent, often superficially so.

clue.text: Rabble roused to howl, wanting fowl and fish

indicators.note: roused means stirred up, and in a down clue the rabble is read upwards

parts.note: a mob is a rabble
a hound's bay is a howl
a duck is a fowl

explanation.surface: A stirred-up crowd baying, with no poultry or seafood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roused' turns MOB up to BOM; 'wanting' is a link. Bombay duck is a dried fish from South Asia, not a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Bombay duck is a lizardfish, eaten dried and salted in Indian cuisine.

clue.text: Fool is to get bad abuse

parts.note: an ass is a fool
to ail is to be sickly or grow unwell

explanation.surface: An idiot is going to receive harsh insults.
explanation.definitionFit: To assail is to attack violently, physically or in words.

clue.text: Work in parts to record in new treaty

indicators.note: in puts the record inside the rearranged treaty letters
new means the letters of treaty are made into something fresh

parts.note: a log is a record

explanation.surface: A clause to be written into a fresh international agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes TETRAY from the treaty letters; 'in' puts the record inside, splitting TETRA from Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetralogy is a work in four connected parts, like Wagner's Ring.

clue.text: What's cardinal point called on compass?

parts.note: rang means called on the phone
E (east) is a cardinal point

explanation.surface: What is a compass point called?
explanation.walkthrough: 'compass' suggests the instrument but means scope.
explanation.definitionFit: Compass in the sense of extent or scope is a synonym of range.

clue.text: Wrapping to protect fruit before entertainment

indicators.note: before places the fruit ahead of the entertainment in the answer

parts.note: a cling (clingstone) is a peach whose flesh sticks to its stone
a film is a piece of entertainment

explanation.surface: Packaging that keeps fruit fresh ahead of a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wrapping to protect fruit' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'protect'; the fruit is CLING, a kind of peach.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin plastic food wrap is used to cover and preserve food.

clue.text: Posed, wearing fine fabric

parts.note: a model sat (posed) for a portrait
wearing a hat means in a hat

explanation.surface: Someone modelled while dressed in an elegant material.
explanation.definitionFit: Satin is a smooth glossy cloth, a classic luxury material.

clue.text: In summary, it's cold in a country's interior

indicators.note: in, with interior after the country, puts the cold letter within the a-plus-country run

parts.note: Peru is a South American country
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: Put briefly, a nation's heartland is chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In summary' sounds like the clue's opening phrase, but 'summary' alone is the definition; C goes inside A PERU.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperçu is a brief outline or quick insight, a short summing-up.

clue.text: Mark of achievement spread about in a joky speech

indicators.note: spread about means the badge is stretched round the following words

parts.note: a badge is awarded as a mark of achievement

explanation.surface: An award is waved around during a humorous talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful banter, light joking conversation.

clue.text: Opera showing artist in European country leading army

indicators.note: leading means the country comes ahead of the army
in places the artist inside the European country

parts.note: Latvia is a Baltic country
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
TA is the Territorial Army

explanation.surface: Opera depicting a painter in a nation heading a military force.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA is Britain's volunteer reserve army.
explanation.definitionFit: La Traviata is Verdi's opera about the courtesan Violetta.

clue.text: Progressive shift in advantage overcoming resistance

indicators.note: overcoming means sitting over, here around, the resistance letter
a shift in something rearranges it, so the letters of advantage are reordered

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A change in the balance of power defeats the opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shift in' rearranges ADVANTAGE to AVANTGADE; 'overcoming' puts R round it, giving AVANTGA-R-DE.
explanation.definitionFit: Avant-garde art is experimental and innovative, ahead of its time.

clue.text: In sauna, made to cook excessively

indicators.note: to cook figuratively means to falsify or rework, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being baked in the steam room for too long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is a link; SAUNA plus MADE is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Ad nauseam is Latin for to the point of sickness, so overdoing something.

clue.text: Wild animal seen when spring returns

indicators.note: returns means the word for spring comes back, read backwards

parts.note: a spring is a flow of water from the ground

explanation.surface: A predator is spotted as the season of spring comes round again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' suggests the season; it is a spring of water, FLOW, reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: The grey wolf is an untamed carnivore of the dog family.

clue.text: Circus performer is to shoot apple

parts.note: to fire is to shoot
an eater is an eating apple, as opposed to a cooker

explanation.surface: A big-top act is going to fire at an apple, William Tell style.
explanation.walkthrough: British greengrocers call dessert apples eaters and cooking apples cookers.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire-eater is a circus act who puts flames in their mouth.

clue.text: One blooming sad cry from stag

parts.note: to feel blue is to feel sad
a stag's rutting roar is called a bell

explanation.surface: A mournful bellow comes from a deer.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluebell is a woodland flower, one that blooms in spring.

clue.text: Sort of thoughtful

definitions.meaning: a ... person is considerate and thoughtful

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a type of thing and a considerate person.

clue.text: In courses, this workman should do his level best

definitions.text: In courses, this workman should do his level best

parts.words: In courses, this workman should do his level best
parts.note: courses are rows of bricks, and this tradesman must keep each one level, a pun on doing one's level best

explanation.definitionFit: A builder who lays bricks in courses checks each row with a spirit level.

clue.text: Draft note caught in part of typewriter

indicators.note: caught in means the note is trapped inside the draft

parts.note: a draft is a plan
te is a note in sol-fa

explanation.surface: A rough sketch of a memo trapped in the machine.
explanation.definitionFit: The platen is the roller a typewriter's keys strike against.

clue.text: Sweetheart's knot

definitions.meaning: a sweetheart is a beloved, one's darling
a love knot of two interlaced loops, symbol of affection

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a beloved person and an ornamental knot symbolising lovers.

clue.text: Bear, to 'Mohican leader, perhaps

parts.note: to tote is to carry or bear

indicators.note: the leader of Mohican is its first letter

explanation.surface: A bear might be a sacred emblem to a Native American chief.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: to a Mohican a bear might be a sacred clan emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an animal or object revered as a clan's emblem among North American peoples.

clue.text: Fine save, clawing away header to grass

parts.note: F is the pencil abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: clawing away the header removes the first letter of the word for save

parts.note: to rescue is to save

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper's great stop, clutching the ball away from a header, onto the turf.
explanation.walkthrough: The football picture misleads: 'header' is the first letter, R, removed from RESCUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Fescue is a genus of tufted grasses common in lawns and pasture.

clue.text: Lots of sailors have a pleasant voyage, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word for a pleasant voyage is said aloud

parts.note: to cruise is to sail at leisure

explanation.surface: Ships' companies enjoy a nice trip, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: Crews are the companies of sailors manning ships, so several groups of seamen.

clue.text: Street map in my possession showing twisting paths

indicators.note: in puts the street map inside the possessive word

parts.note: my possession is what is mine, my
an A-Z is a London street atlas

explanation.surface: I own a city guide full of winding routes.
explanation.walkthrough: The A-Z is the standard British book of street maps.
explanation.definitionFit: Mazy means like a maze, full of winding turns.

clue.text: Taking the paper

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times newspaper

explanation.surface: Picking up the newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking another's property without permission is stealing.

clue.text: Easing of a temper people finally lost

parts.note: a bate is British slang for a fit of temper
men are people

indicators.note: finally means only the last letter of the word lost is used

explanation.surface: A calming down of a temper that folk eventually lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a bate' is British slang for being in a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Abatement is a lessening or reduction, as of a nuisance or tax.

clue.text: Girl receiving warning time is very brief

indicators.note: receiving means the girl's name takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: Mary is a girl's name
an omen is a warning sign

explanation.surface: A young woman gets a premonition that the moment is short.
explanation.definitionFit: Something momentary lasts only an instant, fleeting.

clue.text: Discard king that won't take trick

parts.note: to lose something is to discard or get rid of it
R is short for Rex, king

explanation.surface: Throw away a king, as it won't win a trick at cards.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge a card that will not win a trick is called a loser.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games a losing card is one unable to win a trick.
